Name: SDV Spruceview
Author: mletzk
Description:
Adds a small new village which can be accessed via the CentralStation mod.
Disclaimer: at the point the mod is at, all that's added is a new location and two npcs. However, I will be adding more NPCs and expanding upon the village, with interiors being planned for an upcoming update.
Hint: Try clicking on the doors of the buildings

[b][color=#1e84cc]Required: [/color]
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9599]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Indoor[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]CentralStation[/url]

Also includes an optional additional NPC that requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]

For SDV 1.6

You can find details on all mods developed by the MLETZK team as well as updated changelogs at [url=https://mletzk.github.io/mletzkdevlogs/spruceview][s]MLETZK Devlogs[/s][/url] (Not actively maintained, you will find most changes listed in the Nexus file details)

[b][i][color=#ff0000]Important Notice[/color][/i][/b]

I only upload my mods to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/220272321]Nexus Mods[/url] or [url=https://github.com/mletzk/SDV-Spruceview]Github[/url], if you got them from a separate website or were asked to pay for them, then you may have been scammed, or the files may be illegitimate/compromised. Recently people have noticed that some mods/files both on Nexus and other websites may use SMAPI to inject malware, so always make sure to check the files and ensure they are safe, even if they are obtained from well-known modders on Nexus. I would recommend either manually looking over the files or having someone more knowledgeable look over them as opposed to websites such as VirusTotal as VirusTotal and other anti-viruses are known to mistake legitimate Stardew mods for malware.
